fact_definitions.zero_retention: A vendor-committed path exists to run this model on this route with prompts and outputs not retained at rest. conditional means approval, a setting or a feature limit applies; the note says which. Safety and legal carve-outs are in the notes.
fact_definitions.retention_floor: This model forces retention on this route whatever the buyer sets. Read this fact the other way round: yes means retention is forced. Require zero_retention in a gate, not this fact.
fact_definitions.hipaa_path: A stated route to processing protected health information on this model and route. A vendor statement, not a compliance determination; the signed agreement decides.
fact_definitions.regional_processing: Inference can be pinned to a stated geography on this route. Almost always conditional, because the geographies are limited; the note names them. Storage at rest is a separate question.
fact_definitions.prompt_caching: Prompt or context caching is available on this model and route.
fact_definitions.structured_outputs: Schema-constrained output is available on this model and route.
fact_definitions.computer_use: The vendor documents computer-use tooling on this model and route. The tool still runs in your environment on most routes.
fact_definitions.server_tools: Tools the vendor runs for you, such as web search or code execution, are available on this route.
fact_definitions.remote_mcp: The model API can call a remote MCP server for you on this route, without you running an MCP client.
fact_definitions.batch: An asynchronous batch route exists on this route.
fact_definitions.files_api: A vendor-hosted file store usable from the API exists on this route.
fact_definitions.managed_agents: The model vendor's own hosted agent harness is available on this route. Cloud agent platforms are a separate decision.
fact_definitions.server_fallbacks: The API can fall back to another model server-side on this route when a request is blocked or refused.
fact_definitions.fine_grained_feature_parity: The route gets the model vendor's new features on the same day as the vendor's own API.
